Older Versions of Excel Note ⚠

If you’re not on Microsoft 365 / Excel 2021 / Excel 2024, some things may look different:
- Dynamic arrays (“spill” formulas) may not work the same
- Some features may be missing or different (XLOOKUP, Power Query, Power Pivot)
- You might need copy/paste or classic formulas for a few steps
- Analyze Data / AI tools = Microsoft 365 only (varies by region/language)

I’ll show the modern method first, then the workaround when needed ✅

-------------------------------------------------
Microsoft 365 Online Note
Although you can technically complete up to the first project, many chapters still have limitations you’ll need to navigate.


------------------------------------------------
Navigation Tips for this 11 Hour Video
⏪  Use the "J" key to rewind 10 secs
⏩  Use the "L"  key to fast-forward 10 secs
🪡  Precise Seeking:
     - Tap the screen to see the progress bar
     - Slide up from the scrubber (red dot) to see a row of thumbnails
     - Swipe on the thumbnails to find a specific moment in the video

Power Query is a huge time-saver once you start working with real business data.,

One of the most useful workflows I've worked with is combining SQL Server data with Excel reporting, then automating repetitive transformations.

For larger datasets, I think knowing when to use SQL instead of complex Excel formulas is an important skill.

Do you prefer Power Query, SQL or Python for recurring reports?
